title: Outstandingly Snappy Japanese Beef Ramen
description: A sour and snappy Japanese dish featuring hot beef stock and char-grill-yang flavors, perfect for a crowd, and friendly to shojin dietary preferences. This recipe combines traditional Japanese flavors with a modern twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
Grill the sliced beef to desired doneness.
In a large pot, combine beef bones, water, soy sauce, sake, and mirin, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 4 hours.
Strain the broth and discard the solids.
Cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Slice the grilled beef into thin strips.
Assemble the ramen bowls with noodles, beef, green onions, sesame seeds, and pickled ginger.
Ladle the hot broth over the top and serve immediately.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
